MANUAL-001.description: phoenix-nft-staking ledger 858e9e80 (H-01 value-blind nudge gate, wont-fix) and the race 521c20ad rest on the run-21 premise 'the claim NFT has NO realizable redemption value'. CODE-002.title: Cross-project premise expiry: NFTBonfire gives every NFTMinterV2 claim NFT a permissionless holder-callable redemption (pot of antimatter), invalidating the 'NFT has no realizable redemption value' basis of phoenix-nft-staking wont-fix 858e9e80 and the conditional-harm reasoning on 521c20ad
CODE-002.severity: informational (re-weigh trigger; possible Low/Medium in phoenix-nft-staking after econ quantification)
CODE-002.description: Before story-053 the only burn paths on NFTMinterV2 were authorised-burner contracts (SYA claim). phoenix-nft-staking run-21 closed the BatchNFTMinter nudge-gate finding 858e9e80 as wont-fix on the explicit verified premise that 'NFTMinterV2 has no holder-callable redeem/claim/withdraw path', so the freshly-minted NFTs a nudge snatcher receives are sunk cost. NFTBonfire, once wired (setAuthorizedBurner + Antimatter.setApprovedMinter + non-zero rate), is exactly such a path: any holder of any tokenId can convert 1 NFT into the current pot. Every authorised NFTMinterV2.mintFor caller (e.g. the NFTMigrator granted setAuthorizedMinter in phStaging deploy scripts) and every cheap mint route therefore now mints a redeemable ticket. The realisable value per NFT is bounded by the winner-takes-all pot per accrual interval (the Nth NFT in one interval is worth ~0), so this does NOT by itself prove the nudge gate is now profitable - it moves the bound from 0 to ~ratePerDay x inter-burn interval (capped by maxPayout). The run-21 closure rationale must be re-evaluated against that number; per the expired-closure rule this is its own bucket, not a regression.
CODE-002.attackVector: Conditional: BatchNFTMinter(MultiToken) nudge pot P is claimed by a searcher who receives nudgeSize NFTs; previously value 0, now at least one of them can be bonfired for the pot whenever pot > 0. If P + bonfirePot > qualifying cost, the run-21 '~6.7x sunk-cost margin' argument no longer holds. Also: mintFor-authorised contracts become antimatter faucets bounded only by the pot rate.

ECON-004.description: The run-21 closure of 858e9e80 rested on the verified premise that NFTMinterV2 has no holder-callable redemption path, so a nudge snatcher's 40 freshly minted NFTs are sunk cost. Once phStaging2 wires NFTBonfire (setAuthorizedBurner + Antimatter.setApprovedMinter + a non-zero rate), each NFT can be burned for one pot. The premise is literally false from then on, and per the expired-closure rule the rationale must be re-anchored. Quantitatively, however, the bonfire's contribution to a snatcher's recovery is bounded by the TOTAL emission they can capture, not by NFT count: over horizon T, recovery_AM <= min(ratePerDay x T, 40 x maxPayout [if set]), and the snatcher competes with about 772 idle plus about 4.6k staked NFTs for that stream.
ECON-004.attackPath: Gate economics on the live index-4 BatchNFTMinter: qualifying cost is about 40 x $18.32 = $733 USDS. The owner reports the nudge pot has never exceeded 50% of qualifying cost, so pot <= about $366. The re-arm requires bonfire recovery >= cost - pot, about $367, which is about 412 AM at $0.89. At rate = 2.5 AM/day, even capturing 100% of emission would take about 165 days, during which the remaining NFT holders burn too, so it is not profitable. Thresholds for re-arm within a 7-day horizon: ratePerDay >= about 59 AM/day AND (maxPayout == 0 OR maxPayout >= about 10.3 AM). For RatchetBatchNFTMinter (idx7, $2,800 cost) the thresholds are about 4x higher. Using ECON-003's $3.6 floor does not change the gate math (the gate pins the dispatcher index; the snatcher must pay V2 prices for the 40 qualifying mints).
ECON-004.economicImpact: None at the story-example rate. If the owner later sets a high rate without a cap, the nudge pot becomes atomically or near-term profitable to farm and the 521c20ad race becomes live. Those harms are dilution plus nudge-pot capture, at Medium in phoenix-nft-staking.
ECON-004.routing: Expired-closure note to phoenix-nft-staking (its own bucket, not a regression). Rewrite the 858e9e80 triageReason off 'no realizable value' onto the quantitative bound above. Add re-arm watch: ratePerDay x 7d x v_AM >= (nudgeSize x price - typical pot) with maxPayout x nudgeSize x v_AM above the same bound. 521c20ad keeps its single shared re-arm watch. Also bear in mind that the frozen mainnet BatchNFTMinter (0x068395..., idx4, nudgeSize 40) has no ledger entry of its own (memory note) and the same arithmetic applies to it.
ECON-004.evidence: Live configs: BatchNFTMinter 0x068395 nudgeSize=40 idx=4; RatchetBatchNFTMinter 0x81896f nudgeSize=40 idx=7; V2 idx4 price 18.317665e18 USDS, idx7 70e6 USDC. NFTBonfire.sol:97-112 (one pot per burn, reset to 0).
ECON-004.severityReasoning: Informational here. The premise text has expired but the economic margin has not: break-even needs a rate about 24x the story example, uncapped. Escalate only if the deploy story picks a rate or cap near the thresholds.
ECON-004.confidence: medium (relies on owner-reported nudge-pot history and the current phUSD price)
